title: Panoramic and Immersive Media Studies Yearbook
summary: The PIMS Yearbook surveys the historical and contemporary landscape of panoramic and immersive media. This interdisciplinary field includes—but is not limited to—360-degree paintings dioramas and museum displays gaming gardens immersive experience maps material culture studies media archeology 19th-century popular media optical and haptic devices performative media printed matter public history and virtual and augmented reality.
